About the role
The EAP Care Manager is a mental health professional who provides telephonic and/or live chat support to members accessing the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). This role delivers brief clinical assessment, crisis intervention, solution-focused support, referral coordination, and workplace consultation services. The Care Manager ensures high-quality member experience while adhering to clinical best practices, confidentiality standards, and organizational workflows.
This position is full-time (40 hours/week) Monday - Friday. Applicants must be able to work the schedule below.
Monday - Friday 11:30am-8pm EST
Pay Rate:
$28-35 per hour, commensurate with experience.
Job Summary

• Provide telephonic and/or live chat needs assessment and screening while managing an inbound EAP phone/chat queue.

• Deliver brief, solution-focused, in-the-moment supportive interventions and psychoeducation for concerns including stress, anxiety, grief, relationship issues, and substance use.

• Conduct risk assessments for members presenting with concerns such as: suicidal ideation; thoughts of harm to others; substance use issues; risk for abuse or violence.

• Provide crisis intervention and stabilization, including safety planning and connection to urgent or emergent resources when indicated.

• Explain EAP clinical and work/life benefits and provide individualized recommendations to meet each member’s needs and goals.

• Connect members to EAP services and/or health insurance or community resources and follow up to support successful engagement and connection to services, as clinically appropriate.

• May provide consultation and support to HR and Managers regarding employee performance concerns, crisis support, or other issues within EAP scope, while maintaining professional boundaries and confidentiality.

• May assist with Critical Incident Response following a Disruptive Event in the workplace, providing telephonic in-the-moment support to members and/or assisting with arranging onsite or virtual counseling at the worksite.

• Document all interactions and activities accurately and timely in the electronic case management system.

• Adhere to ethical standards, clinical best practices, and confidentiality requirements, including HIPAA and applicable regulations.

• Participate in individual supervision, team meetings, and case consultation.

• Collaborate effectively with colleagues to ensure high-quality member care.

• Maintain reliable attendance and availability for scheduled shifts and caseload responsibilities.

• Complete required trainings and maintain competency in EAP protocols and procedures.

• Participate in the EAP on-call rotation to provide after-hours coverage (evenings, weekends, and holidays), typically assigned approximately two weeks per calendar year.

• Master’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, Psychology, or a related behavioral

title: Head of Gusto Controls
description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff - payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR - so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) - because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a Head of Internal Controls to join Gusto’s Finance, BizOps & Strategy team. This leader will partner with accounting and technical leaders to build and scale a forward-thinking internal controls environment that supports Gusto’s growth and operational maturity.

As the Head of Internal Controls, you will lead Gusto’s controls program across business process controls and IT controls. The scope includes the proprietary and third-party systems supporting Gusto’s payroll, health benefits, retirement, and other financial products.

You will build the team, set the program’s strategy, and embed practical controls into how Gusto’s products, systems, and financial processes are designed and operated. You will also define what an AI-forward internal controls function can look like, both by applying AI to controls work and by establishing oversight of AI-enabled financial processes and software development.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on controls leader who has built or scaled an ICFR program and led experienced teams. They can engage collaboratively with accounting and technical leaders, understand proprietary systems and complex data flows, and translate risk into controls that support the business without creating unnecessary operational burden.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

• Build and lead Gusto’s internal controls function, bringing business process controls and IT controls together under a single program and developing the team needed to support both areas.

• Own Gusto’s risk-based ICFR framework across financial processes and the systems and data that support them, including scoping, control design, documentation, testing, issue evaluation, and remediation.

• Strengthen the control environment supporting Gusto’s complex operations, proprietary systems, and evolving products.

• Partner early with Accounting, Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, Security, and Risk to build control and auditability into new products, systems, and processes without creating unnecessary manual work or disruption.

• Set the vision for an AI-forward internal controls function, using AI and automation to rethink how risk is identified, evidence is evaluated, and controls are tested and monitored. Establish practical oversight for risks introduced by AI-enabled financial processes and software development.

• Lead the relationship with external auditors, ensuring alignment on risk, scope, testing, evidence, and remediation.

• Establish clear governance and accountability for internal controls, including training across Gusto and reporting to senior management and the Audit Committee on the program’s health and effectiveness.

Here’s what we're looking for:

• 12+ years of progressive experience in a Big 4 accounting firm, internal audit, or SOX compliance role program in a complex, scaling organization with professional certifications like CIA or CISA. 

• 5+ years of people leadership experience, with a track record of hiring, coaching, and developing experienced controls professiona

title: Principal Power Controls Engineer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril is seeking an experienced Principal Power Controls Engineer (acting SME) to develop and implement advanced control algorithms for high-performance power electronic systems. We're looking for someone with deep expertise in control system modeling and simulation - particularly in Simulink and PLECS - who can take a controls concept from simulation through hardware validation. This individual will own the control architecture for DC/DC converters, inverters, and motor drives built around discrete SiC and GaN power stages, and will work closely with power hardware and firmware engineers to deliver tightly integrated, high-reliability systems for defense and aerospace applications.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Design, simulate, and validate closed-loop control algorithms for switch-mode power converters and inverters using Simulink and/or PLECS.

• Controls for 3-phase AC systems, with and without a switched Neutral

• Develop plant models and controller architectures (voltage-mode, current-mode, sensorless FOC, etc.) for multi-kW power stages utilizing discrete SiC and GaN FETs.

• Perform stability analysis, loop shaping, and compensator design to meet transient response, efficiency, and EMI targets.

• Collaborate with power hardware engineers on gate drive tuning, dead-time optimization, and switching-loss characterization of wide-bandgap devices.

• Support model-based code generation workflows and work with firmware engineers to translate control designs into embedded implementations.

• Define and execute hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and power-hardware-in-the-loop (PHIL) test plans to validate control performance against system requirements.

• Contribute to trade studies on converter topology, modulation strategy, and control bandwidth as they relate to size, weight, power, and thermal constraints.

title: Product Manager, Xsolla Ads
description:
ABOUT US
Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
For more information, visit xsolla.com.
ABOUT THE ROLE
The Xsolla Offerwall puts rewarded offers in front of players inside the games and apps of our publishers. A player opens the wall, picks an offer, completes it, and earns in-game currency. Whether they do depends on what they see: the offer card, the creative, the video, the playable, and the reward moment.
Those units come from several places. Some are native offers we render ourselves. Some arrive as VAST video, HTML or MRAID creatives, or OpenRTB Native assets from demand partners. Each format has its own rules, and each one has to look right in a publisher's game, on a phone, without breaking what the advertiser sent.
You'll own how offerwall ads look and perform. You'll decide which formats we support and how they render. You'll design what the player sees, and turn that into specs engineers can build from. You'll measure whether a change made players more likely to engage, and you'll use AI to make better creative faster than a manual process allows.
 
RESPONSIBILITIES
Ad experience and creative
Own the look and feel of every ad unit in the offerwall: offer cards, detail pages, video, playables, interstitials, and the reward flow.
Set creative standards for advertisers and publishers: layouts, asset specs, safe areas, aspect ratios, and branding rules.
Balance three groups who want different things: players want a clean experience, publishers want it to match their game, and advertisers want their brand shown properly.
oRTB formats and rendering
Define how we support VAST, HTML and MRAID, and OpenRTB Native inside the offerwall, across Web, iOS, Android, and Unity.
Write the requirements for format support: which VAST events we track, which MRAID calls we allow, and how Native assets map into our own templates.
Work with Engineering on creative QA and rejection rules, so broken or non-compliant creatives get caught before a player sees them.
Design to engineering
Turn ideas into Figma designs and prototypes that engineers can build without guessing.
Write PRDs and acceptance criteria that cover states, edge cases, and device differences, not just the happy path.
Work with our designers on the offerwall's design system, and keep it consistent across publishers and platforms.
Experimentation and performance
Run A/B tests on layouts, creative treatments, and formats, and read the results yourself.
Track the metrics that show whether the ad experience works: CTR, video completion rate, offer start and completion rates, IPM, and eCPM.
Turn what you learn into a prioritized roadmap, and explain the tradeoffs to Engineering, Demand, and leadership.
AI in creative and workflow
Find where AI can improve ad units: generating creative variants, adapting assets to new formats, auto-cropping and localization, and checking creative quality.
Use AI tools in your own work: prototyping, writing specs, analyzing test results, and getting from idea to something testable faster.
Cross-functional work
Work with Engineering, Design, Demand, Publisher Success, and Data every week.
Give the Demand team clear creative guidelines they can share with advertisers.
Bring what publishers and advertisers say back into the roadmap, in a form engineers can

title: Transaction Monitoring Lead (Card & Crypto Payments)

Why Reap ?

This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, and brings order to complexity.
What You’ll Do

• Draft, maintain, and own SOPs for the TM function, aligned with policies owned by FCC.

• Translate regulatory and scheme requirements into actionable process steps and control points.

• Define L1 vs. L2 escalation matrices, investigation standards, and QC checkpoints.

4) Mentorship & Leadership

• Serve as subject matter expert for TM, mentoring peers and setting investigation quality standards.

• Lead knowledge-sharing sessions, write playbooks, and uplevel the team's capability through example and coaching.

What We’re Looking For
Must-haves

• 8-12+ years focused on Transaction Monitoring.

• Background in Fintech, Payments (card issuing and/or acquiring), or Web3/Crypto with a clear grasp of differences between fiat rails and blockchain flows.

• Deep knowledge of Visa/Mastercard scheme monitoring obligations and relevant AML and fraud typologies.

• Hands-on experience with modern TM and blockchain analytics tools (e.g., Unit21, Flagright, Chainalysis, Elliptic) and the ability to articulate rule logic.

• Start-up mindset: willing to clear alerts while building strategy, comfortable operating in evolving environments.

Nice-to-haves

• CAMS, CFE, or ICA International Diploma in AML.

• Prior experience standing up a TM function or migrating from manual to automated monitoring.

• Working proficiency in SQL and/or data visualization for rule performance analysis and experiment design.

Why You'll Love it Here

• Flexible hybrid/remote work environment with a global, collaborative team.

• Use of AI tools at work - and the space to learn, experiment, and grow with them.

• A culture of innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning.

ROLE SUMMARY

We’re hiring a manager to lead our Developer Advocates in APJ. The team covers two things: getting more developers in the region to discover and try Temporal, and helping our biggest customers get more out of it once they’re on board. You’ll own both.

You’ll manage a group of developer advocates, but you won’t be stuck in meetings all day. We expect you to still give talks, run workshops, write code, and get in front of customers yourself. You’ll work closely with our Marketing department on events and community, and with Sales, Solutions Architects, and Developer Success on customer accounts. Good relationships with all of them are your key to success.

What you’ll do

- Hire, coach, and support a team of Developer Advocates spread across the region. Set priorities, then trust them to adapt to their own markets and audiences.

- You like running programs that work the same way every time. You’re organized about requests, priorities, and following through on commitments.

Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds.

THE HARDWARE VERTICAL AT HEXA: FRONTIER TECH

Frontier Tech is Hexa’s studio focused on physical tech, led by Guerric de Crombrugghe.

We build companies that move atoms: real machines, deployed in the field, often for defense, energy, space and critical infrastructure. A few examples of what is on the bench today include containerized atmospheric water generators, expendable turbojets, and ship-borne satellite ground stations.

Our edge is velocity. We go from idea to working hardware with small teams and lean budgets, against legacy players with hundreds of engineers and decade-long programs. AI is now the biggest lever we have to widen that gap, today by speeding up how we build, and tomorrow by shaping what kind of companies we build.

WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW

AI for hardware is moving faster than any team can track. Our internal map now tracks close to 200 tools, from text-to-CAD, AI-native electronics and physics surrogates to manufacturing, test data, procurement and the MCP connectors that let agents drive CAD and EDA tools directly.

Most of these tools will not matter. A handful will cut weeks off our programs. We need someone whose job is to find those, prove them on our real parts, and put them in the hands of our founders before our competitors do.

- Build companies that grow with AI. Design products and business models that are both AI-enabled (they get better with every new generation of models) and AI-enablers (they feed AI with the data, compute, energy or infrastructure it needs), and run the companies themselves on AI from day one. The goal is a positive feedback loop: the more AI grows, the more our companies grow.

Adoption is the immediate focus. The role splits into two:

80%: deploy AI inside our ventures

You ship parts and files, not slides.

title: Senior Android Engineer
description:
About Epic

Epic Kids is the leading digital reading platform built for kids 12 and under, trusted by millions of children, educators, and families around the world. Our mission is to inspire a lifelong love of reading by providing unlimited access to thousands of high-quality books, videos, and educational content through a safe and engaging experience. We combine technology, storytelling, and learning innovation to help every child become a confident reader.
At Epic , you'll join a collaborative and fast-paced global team passionate about building meaningful products that make a real impact on children's education and literacy.
About the role
You'll own Epic 's native Android app, the main way kids open a book on Android phones, tablets and Chromebooks. It's a large, mature Kotlin codebase with some Java and xml UI layouts. You'll work independently and partner closely with our Android, iOS, backend and web engineers and with the US engineering team.
What you'll do

• Own and evolve the Android app across phones, tablets and Chromebooks.

• Own the reading experience: our in-house page renderer and page-flip animation, zoom and gestures, and Read-to-Me audio synced to word highlighting.

• Own offline reading (encrypted downloads, background work, local storage), Google Play Billing subscriptions, and the Play Store release pipeline.

• Drive performance, stability and quality: startup time, memory, ANRs and crashes, and test coverage.

• Modernize carefully: move legacy Java and RxJava code forward without breaking a live app. also move to compose UIs whenever possible.

• Over time, pick up some iOS/Swift work.

What we're looking for

• 4 - 6 years of building and shipping native Android apps.

• Strong Kotlin, and comfortable working in mixed Kotlin and Java code.

• Deep experience with the Android View system, Fragments and custom Views: custom drawing, animation and touch handling.

• Reactive and async programming: RxJava 2 in production, plus Kotlin coroutines.

• Dependency injection, MVP or MVVM architecture and Networking with Retrofit and OkHttp.

• Local persistence with Room/SQLite, including schema migrations, and background work with WorkManager.

• Google Play Billing and the release pipeline: Gradle build variants, app signing, CI (Jenkins or similar), Play Console tracks and staged rollouts.

• Testing with JUnit, Mockito or MockK, Robolectric and Espresso.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

• Media: ExoPlayer/Media3, MediaPlayer, and syncing audio to text.

• Handling encrypted media and content stored offline.

• Jetpack Compose, and the judgment to know when it fits alongside an existing View-based codebase.

• Performance tooling: Perfetto, Android Studio profilers, LeakCanary, New Relic or Crashlytics.

• Experience with kids' or education apps and children's privacy rules (COPPA).

• Interest in cross-platform mobile and some familiarity with iOS/Swift.

Compensation
40-50 LPA, with some flexibility for exceptional candidates.

From day one, we’ve grown without external funding; scaling profitably through technology, disciplined execution, and deep medical expertise. What started as a challenger idea has become one of the most significant healthcare platforms operating globally today.

A key driver of our success is vertical integration; we operate our own manufacturing and proprietary products, led by in-house medical teams, researchers, and pharmacists at the top of their fields.

In 2025, HeliosX treated more than 1.7 million patients globally and reached £781m in revenue, representing +337% year-on-year growth and cementing our position as the clear market leader in the UK. That growth translates into real-world outcomes: our weight-loss treatments helped patients lose 8.5 million kilograms of excess weight in 2025 alone, contributing to an estimated 1,300 fewer cardiac events. This is growth with measurable, life-changing impact at scale.

Today, we operate across four international markets, with successful launches in Germany and Canada and continued expansion in the US. We were also recently recognised in the Sunday Times Top 100 fastest-growing tech companies, further validation of both our momentum and our ambition.

Where we’re going:

2026 is another significant year for HeliosX. Our ambition is to surpass £1.1bn in revenue, continue expanding thoughtfully into new international markets and broaden our condition and treatment portfolio. As we scale, we're focused on building the technology, operational excellence and clinical capabilities that will support sustainable long-term growth. Joining HeliosX now means helping shape the systems, teams and products that will define the next chapter of digital healthcare. You'll be solving complex problems at pace, working alongside exceptional people and building products that genuinely improve lives at scale.

There’s never been a more exciting time to join HeliosX. Come be a part of making our dream of easier and faster healthcare a reality!

title: Behavioral Health Care Manager
description:
Are you passionate about increasing access to behavioral health services? Have you worked in Collaborative Care? Are you available to work evenings in your time zone? If so, we want you to join the April Health team as a Behavioral Health Care Manager.

About April Health

April Health is working to deliver high-quality, virtual behavioral health services to patients in the United States. Through the Collaborative Care model, an evidence-based model for treating behavioral health issues in primary care, April Health enables access to behavioral health services through healthcare providers that patients already know and trust.

April Health partners with primary care, women’s health, and pediatric practices to provide a hybrid behavioral health solution that combines human care management with AI-driven support to improve patient outcomes, reduce provider burden, and generate new revenue for our partners. Patients conduct regular appointments with our behavioral health care managers, receive guidance from psychiatrists, and our AI Therapeutic Coach helps patients between appointments, maximizing the value that patients receive in our program.

The Role

The Behavioral Health Care Manager is the primary point of contact for patients who are enrolled with April Health . This person is responsible for coordinating the patient’s care with the patient's primary care provider and consulting psychiatrist, tracking the patient’s symptoms with validated measurement tools, and directly meeting with the patient to deliver evidence-based treatments.

The Collaborative Care Model is a population-based approach to managing mental health in the primary care setting and is not a traditional psychotherapy model of care. Instead, we offer brief evidence-based interventions to patients, such as motivational interviewing, problem-solving treatment, and behavioral activation.

Responsibilities

• Support and closely coordinate mental health care with the patient’s primary care provider, establishing a mutually agreeable care plan

• Screen and assess patients for common mental health disorders

• Support psychotropic medication management prescribed by PCPs, focusing on treatment adherence, side effects and other complications, and treatment effectiveness

• Track patient follow-up and clinical outcomes using a registry, record encounters in the registry, and use the system to identify and re-engage patients

• Plan specific mutual self-management goals, objectives, and behavioral interventions with action-oriented patients

• Facilitate care plan changes for patients who are not improving, including changes in medications or psychosocial treatments or appropriate referrals for additional services

• Participate in regularly scheduled caseload consultations with psychiatric consultants

Background and Skills

• Background in providing care to patients struggling with mental health disorders

• Experience working in a team-based healthcare setting

• At least three years of clinical work experience

• Proficiency in evidence-based treatment approaches (Problem Solving Treatment, Motivational Interviewing, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Behavioral Activation)

• Experience using measurement-based care tools (PHQ9, GAD7, C-SSRS, etc.)

• Masters degree in a mental health-related field

Key Attributes

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate and communicate effectively in a team setting

• Ability to maintain effective and professional relationships with patients and other members of the care team

• Ability to effectively engage patients in a therapeutic relationship

• Experience with telemedicine and comfort working with patients by telephone and video calls

• Interpersonally adaptable, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited to work in a startup environment

Our Top Perks

• Competitive compensation

• Remote work

• Fantastic total rewards package, including health, vision, dental, etc.

• Working equipment allowance

Salary: $53,000 - $58,000 / yea

You will own the inference backbone behind QVAC's local AI stack: the C++ systems layer that makes models run fast, reliably, and predictably on real user hardware. The role is centered on engineering quality at runtime level, including startup behavior, memory pressure, throughput/latency balance, and long-session stability. You will define and evolve the core abstractions that inference features depend on, so new capabilities can be added without sacrificing performance or maintainability. This is a role for someone who enjoys low-level problem solving, clear technical ownership, and building infrastructure that other teams trust in production. Your work directly enables private, on-device AI experiences and helps set the technical foundation for QVAC's next generation of peer-to-peer AI products.

About the job
You'll work on the C++ layer that powers local AI, porting and enhancing inference engines like llama.cpp or similar, to run efficiently on edge devices. Your focus is on the runtime: making models load faster, run leaner, and perform well across different hardware. You'll ensure that the inference layer is stable, optimized, and ready for integration with the rest of the stack.
This role is for engineers who want to work close to the metal, enabling private and fast on-device AI without relying on cloud infrastructure.

Responsibilities

title: [Job-32473] Software Architecture Manager, Brazil
description:
Na CI&T , ajudamos grandes empresas a transformar o potencial da AI em impacto real nos negócios com AI Deployment, execução AI-native e tech-integrated business solutions.

Com 30 anos de experiência em transformação tecnológica, aceleramos inovação com expertise em agentic SDLC, application modernization, Data & AI, martech e business strategy.

Somos 8.000 CI&Ters em mais de 25 países, colaborando para construir soluções com impacto real. AI já faz parte da forma como trabalhamos, evoluímos e inovamos todos os dias.

Importante : se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.
Buscamos uma pessoa Software Architecture Manager com forte profundidade técnica, visão sistêmica e perfil hands-on para liderar a arquitetura do portfólio CI&T Flow e de soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial.

Responsabilidades:
1. Visão Sistêmica e Estratégia de Arquitetura:
- Definir e evoluir a arquitetura do portfólio CI&T Flow, considerando produtos, plataformas, agentes de IA, dados, integrações e infraestrutura.
- Compreender sistemas end-to-end, identificando dependências, riscos, gargalos e oportunidades de simplificação e reutilização.
- Estabelecer arquiteturas de referência, padrões técnicos e guardrails que acelerem a engenharia sem comprometer qualidade e escalabilidade.
- Garantir coerência arquitetural entre as soluções, equilibrando necessidades específicas dos clientes e evolução da plataforma.
2. Gestão de Portfólio e Priorização:

• Liderar a priorização técnica das iniciativas, considerando impacto de negócio, esforço, capacidade disponível, dependências e riscos.
- Trabalhar com as lideranças de Pré-Venda, Pós-Venda, Produto e Engenharia para alinhar prioridades e direcionar investimentos técnicos.
- Gerenciar trade-offs entre demandas imediatas, evolução arquitetural e sustentabilidade das soluções.
- Identificar oportunidades de reutilização de componentes, aceleradores e capacidades da plataforma.
- Garantir foco nas iniciativas que geram maior valor para o negócio e para os clientes.
3. Liderança Técnica Hands-on:
- Atuar diretamente em decisões arquiteturais complexas, code reviews, debugging, troubleshooting e resolução de problemas críticos.
- Desenvolver PoCs, protótipos e implementações de referência para validar hipóteses e reduzir incertezas técnicas.
- Trabalhar próximo aos times de engenharia, contribuindo diretamente com código e decisões de implementação quando necessário.
- Avaliar novas tecnologias e abordagens por meio de experimentação prática.
- Promover excelência em engenharia, automação, CI/CD, DevSecOps, testes e observabilidade.
4. Arquitetura de Soluções AI-Based:
- Liderar o desenho e a evolução de soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes de IA e automação inteligente.
- Definir padrões de orquestração, integração, gerenciamento de contexto, memória, observabilidade e governança de agentes.
- Promover arquiteturas que favoreçam produtividade, autonomia, segurança, escalabilidade e eficiência de custos.
- Trabalhar com Produto e Engenharia na evolução contínua das capacidades do CI&T Flow.
5. Pré-Venda, Pós-Venda e Engenharia de Valor:
- Atuar como referência técnica em oportunidades comerciais, discoveries, propostas e discussões arquiteturais com clientes.
- Garantir consistência entre o que é proposto, vendido, entregue e operado.
- Apoiar projetos estratégicos, implantação de soluções e resolução de desafios técnicos complexos.
- Estruturar blueprints, aceleradores e playbooks que facilitem a adoção e escalabilidade das soluções.
- Utilizar métricas e Value Stream Mapping para identificar gargalos, orientar prioridades e maximizar resultados.
6. Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Pessoas:
- Liderar e desenvolver arquitetos(as), tech leads e engenheiros(as) seniores.
- Promover autonomia, ownership, colaboração e excelência técnica.
- Apoiar decisões de contratação, composição de equipes e desenvolvim

title: Фахівець з моделювання поведінки клієнтів
description:
Наш аналітичний відділ CRM шукає аналітика/аналітикиню, бажано з досвідом написання прогностичних моделей.
Гадаємо, ти в курсі, що Київстар - це титан у світі телекомунікаційних послуг. А ще це крутий роботодавець, з який комфортно. Надсилай нам своє резюме, якщо хочеш:

•    Бути частиною команди мрії, що завжди підтримує та надихає
•    Миттєво влитися у новий колектив в режимі онлайн завдяки нашій програмі онборінгу
•    Отримувати гідну та повністю офіційну оплату, з приємними бонусами за якісну роботу
•    Мати потужний соцпакет - з медичною страховкою та допомогою у складних життєвих ситуаціях
•    Прокачати свої скіли на постійних онлайн тренінгах, курсах, майстер-класах
•    Невпинно розвиватися як спеціаліст
Ось що ти будеш робити в Київстар:

•    Аналізувати, наскільки ефективно та якісно проходять цільові кампанії Київстару, готувати по ним звіти
•    Досліджувати клієнтську базу даних, визначати фактори, що описують поведінку абонентів
•    Готувати бізнес-кейси та прогнози (відтік, результати кампаній, доходи)
•    Працювати з  моделями та алгоритмами поведінки клієнтів: складати, тестувати їх валідність на контрольних та експериментальних групах, впроваджувати в експлуатацію, передавати замовникам, надавати експертну підтримку, доробляти або модифікувати за необхідності
•    Готувати регулярні та Ad-Hoc звіти, аналізувати дані в різних розрізах, доповнювати їх звітами з розгорнутими з коментарями та поясненнями (аналітичними записками)
•    Розробляти методики та процедури за напрямком аналітичного CRM
Ми чекаємо саме на тебе, якщо:

•    В тебе вже є від 2 років досвіду роботи в сфері аналізу ефективності продуктів та маркетингових кампаній або стратегічного/маркетингового аналізу та прогнозування.
•    Ти на одному диханні аналізуєш первинну та вторинну інформацію, вмієш її узагальнювати та систематизувати, виділяєш важливі фактори, явища та події, оцінюєш їх вплив
•    Ти добре знаєш SQL та без проблем оперуєш великими масивами даних

title: Broker Development Manager
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

Brokers bring in nearly all of Flock’s business, so they’re central to how we grow. As a Broker Development Manager, you’ll look after a panel of key broker partners with real growth potential, deepen the relationships we already have and build new ones as we move into new sectors. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution.

You’ll show brokers what our connected fleet proposition does for their clients: it cuts risk and cost and keeps drivers safer. We’re AI-first, so you’ll use AI every day to research brokers, prepare for meetings and spot opportunities across your panel, leaving more time for the conversations that win business.

 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

- Be the main face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners and grow the business you do together.

- Drive a high volume of quality submissions from your panel.

- Grow the panel, onboarding new brokers quickly and getting them trading.

- Find new ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors.

- Build data-led growth plans for each account and follow them through.

- Support day-to-day trading so brokers win and keep business with Flock, keeping conversion and retention high.

- Work with underwriting, product and other teams across Flock towards shared growth goals.

- Use AI daily for broker research, meeting prep and pipeline analysis.

 

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- At least five years managing broker relationships in insurance, with a strong reputation in the market.

- An existing network of broker contacts you can bring to Flock from day one.

- A strong understanding of the commercial broker market, competing carriers and how broker businesses work.

- A track record of beating revenue targets and working well with teams across a business.

- A consultative sales approach that matches Flock’s proposition to what each broker needs.

- Pace and energy: you move fast, spot opportunities and solve problems.

- Comfortable using AI at work and curious about where else it could help you win business.

Nice to have: experience building broker networks in Commercial Motor Fleet, an active broker panel in commercial insurance, or a record of taking new technology or products to brokers.

 

BENEFITS

- 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

- Share Incentive Plan 📈

- Workplace Pension 💰

- Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

- Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

- Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

- £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

- £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

- 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

This role is expected to be field based rather than office based, working with brokers across Manchester and the surrounding region, so visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days. As long as you’re meeting brokers consistently each week, time at our Central London office, a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street, can be weekly or monthly.
